# BorderedElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for elements with borders and background colors. Provides common functionality for drawing borders and backgrounds.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IBackgroundColor`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BorderedElementBase()
```

## Properties

- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Background color for this element (undefined = transparent).
- [`border`](#border): Border widths for each side of the element.
- [`borderColors`](#bordercolors): Border colors for each side of the element
- [`cornerRadius`](#cornerradius): Corner radius for rounded rectangles.

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor: Color | undefined
```

Background color for this element (undefined = transparent).

Accepts a palette token (`'slate-100'`) or hex (`'#ff00aa'`) on write.

### `border`

```typescript
border: Border
```

Border widths for each side of the element.

Reads as the canonical [`Border`](border.md); accepts a uniform width or a per-side object on write. Colour is set through `borderColors` - this setter never writes it.

### `borderColors`

```typescript
borderColors: BorderColors
```

Border colors for each side of the element

### `cornerRadius`

```typescript
cornerRadius: number
```

Corner radius for rounded rectangles. 0 = sharp corners (default).

Accepts a length: `6`, `'2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
